channel.title: Apartment Zero Waste Guide
channel.description: Practical composting and zero-waste guides for apartment dwellers and renters. Learn odorless composting methods, kitchen waste reduction, indoor gardening, and renter-friendly sustainability tips.

item.description: Learn how to compost under your kitchen sink without odors, leaks, or lease violations. Perfect for renters who want to reduce food waste in small spaces.
